# AyoSim

> Interactive in-browser hardware simulation platform for Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi by AYOT.

AyoSim is an advanced in-browser hardware simulation platform that lets engineers, students, and makers build, simulate, and debug embedded electronics without physical hardware.

- Portal URL: https://ayosim.vercel.app/
- Organization: AYOT
- Supported Languages: English, French, Arabic (with native RTL support)
- Platform Mode: 100% In-Browser (zero installation, zero drivers, zero setup)

## Core Simulators

- [AyoSim Arduino](https://ayosim-arduino.vercel.app/): ATmega328P 8-bit AVR virtual core @ 16 MHz, 14 digital I/O pins, 6 PWM channels, 6 ADC inputs, 32KB flash memory, 2KB SRAM buffer, and UART serial monitor bridge @ 115200 baud.
- [AyoSim ESP32](https://ayosim-esp32.vercel.app/): Dual-core Tensilica Xtensa LX6 @ 240 MHz, FreeRTOS kernel scheduler, virtual 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE 4.2) stack, 4MB SPI Flash, and 520KB internal SRAM heap.
- [AyoSim Raspberry Pi](https://ayosim-rpi.vercel.app/): Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz, embedded Linux kernel v6.1 & systemd rootfs, Python 3.11 runtime, and memory-mapped 40-pin GPIO header.

## Key Differentiators & Comparisons

- **AyoSim vs Wokwi**: AyoSim features full Raspberry Pi simulation with Linux kernel emulation, Python execution, and 40-pin GPIO (Wokwi only supports the RP2040 Raspberry Pi Pico microcontroller, not a full Linux SBC). AyoSim also includes ESP32 Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) simulation, which Wokwi does not support. AyoSim is fully trilingual (English, French, Arabic).
- **AyoSim vs Tinkercad**: Tinkercad Circuits is limited to basic Arduino and has neither ESP32 nor Raspberry Pi support. AyoSim supports Arduino, ESP32 with Wi-Fi & BLE, and full Raspberry Pi with Linux terminal and Python runtime.

## Resources & Links

- [Full Machine Specification](https://ayosim.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive hardware specifications, comparison matrices, and FAQs.
- [Tutorials](https://ayosim.vercel.app/#tutorials): 50+ step-by-step embedded electronics tutorials.
- [Projects](https://ayosim.vercel.app/#projects): Real-world IoT, automation, and robotics projects.
